Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: [ACTION] Scheduling global product demo — potential holiday/DST conflicts

Hi all —

Thanks again for the interest — excited to get a 60-minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference scheduled. I put together a short agenda (attached) and a couple of proposed slots that try to be timezone-friendly across US / EU / APAC.

Quick context and ask:
- We noticed some region-specific OOO windows coming up (Golden Week in Japan late April, Diwali in India in Oct/Nov) and there are DST transitions in March/April for US & EU that shift local meeting times.
- To avoid last-minute reschedules, I wanted to propose either a single global session with a 30-minute overlap for live Q&A OR two shorter region-focused sessions (Americas/EU and APAC) back-to-back with a 20–30 minute joint Q&A.

Proposed slots (all times also attached as an .ics):
A) Tue 2027-04-26 10:00–11:00 PT / 18:00–19:00 CET / 02:00–03:00 JST (next day) — single session (note: falls just before Golden Week starts for JP customers)
B) Wed 2027-05-05 09:00–09:45 PT (Americas/EU focus) + 09:45–10:30 PT (APAC overlap Q&A) — split sessions with overlap

Please reply with: (1) preferred approach (single global vs split), (2) preferred slot A or B, and (3) any absolute blackout dates (I noted Golden Week, Easter bank holidays in EU, and the US DST week).

Attachments: demo-agenda-v1.pdf; proposed-times.ics

Thanks — happy to iterate.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options and the agenda — helpful. Quick notes from the UK/EU side:
- Easter bank holidays (Good Friday / Easter Monday) fall in early April this year; that week is tight for several stakeholders and EU DST shift happens the weekend of 27–28 Mar which affects morning availability immediately after.
- For our execs, anything the week of 26 Apr is possible but prefer earlier in the week (Mon/Tue) rather than late in the week.

Preference: split sessions (option B) looks better for us — it lets regional teams attend the most relevant portion and keeps the joint Q&A focused. If you do split, please confirm local times in CET/BST and include calendar invites with both timezones explicitly stated (we've had confusion in past invites).

Also, please include a short pre-demo checklist of topics we should prep on our side (data residency, SLAs, integration points) so we can bring the right folks.

Best,
Emma Smith
Head of Platforms — FinServ Group
emma.smith@finserv.co.uk
